= Secondary Current Distribution (cd)
:page-toclevels: 2
:description: Current distribution in an electrolyte with electrode kinetics (primary: equilibrium electrodes; secondary: Butler-Volmer, Tafel, linearized or user-defined kinetics)
:page-math: true

== Boundary features

[#cd-es]
=== Electrode Surface

Electrode reaction at the electrolyte boundary: overpotential eta = phis_ext - Eeq - phil, local current density i_loc(eta) entering the electrolyte (anodic positive).

Selection: Boundaries · Physics ribbon › Boundaries, or right-click the interface in the Model Builder

latexmath:[-\mathbf{n}\cdot\mathbf{i}_l = i_{loc}(\eta),\quad \eta = \phi_{s,ext}-E_{eq}-\phi_l]
